Class MultiblockMember

java.lang.Object
fr.robie.machineengine.api.multiblock.MultiblockMember
All Implemented Interfaces:
MachineBehavior
public final class MultiblockMember extends Object implements MachineBehavior
A block of a multiblock (D33): a frame block, valve or port, as a machine behavior. Each finds its structure when it loads (or is placed), and unforms it when removed. The anchor sizes its storages for the structure and checks it again every few seconds (blocks placed inside, cells added...). A member that passes through (storages given) shows the anchor's storages on all its sides.

Built with of(List); data-driven machines use the behavior type machineengine:multiblock_member.
